caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat. The chair is drawn in a three-quarter perspective, showing two front legs, two back legs that extend vertically to form the backrest, and horizontal supports between the legs near the floor. The seat is made from interlaced strips, illustrated with both brown and beige tones, indicating wood or woven material. The backrest consists of two horizontal slats, both shaded in brown, with rounded tops on the vertical supports extending slightly above the uppermost slat. Measurements are noted, including a width of 14 inches at the seat, height of 8 1/2 inches for the seat from the floor, and a total back height of 22 inches. There are minor pencil annotations detailing construction methods and materials. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller sketch showing a top-down view of the woven seat pattern, also in pencil with some brown coloration. The drawing is primarily created with light pencil lines, with some sections shaded or colored tips in brown to highlight the wood texture and woven elements.
title: Child's Chair
